summary: Zero-pad WAL segment names; the reason is a consumer in another module (compactor.py sorts names as strings), so the explanation belongs at the producer in segments.py.

required_facts.text: Zero-pad the sequence number to a fixed width because compactor.py picks the newest segment by sorting file names as strings.
also_matching: Zero-pad to a fixed width: compactor.latest_segment picks the active segment by sorting names as strings, so segment 10 must sort after 9.
Pad with leading zeros because compactor.py orders segment names lexicographically.
compactor.py picks the newest segment by string sort, so the sequence number needs a fixed width.
Fixed-width names keep the compactor's string comparison in numeric order.

forbidden_claims.text: XFS returns directory entries in a different order, so the listing order is wrong.
